_comment: Conversations, not sentences. Each is several turns from one person, and each turn is scored with every earlier turn and every earlier answer in front of the model, the way a host keeps them. They are written in the patterns real people were recorded using, not in the phrasing a tool description suggests. Sources: the words farmers used in the May 2024 storm (Iowa Capital Dispatch, Albert Lea Tribune, AP via Fox); older adults' month of recorded Alexa use, where a quarter of turns failed and repeating, rephrasing and 'never mind' were the usual repairs (Mahmood, Wang and Huang, arXiv 2403.02421); and 844 recorded voice-assistant check-ins whose breakdowns were mostly about earlier turns ('what about yesterday though?') and asking why (Mathur and others, arXiv 2510.06690). tool null means the right answer calls nothing. anyOf lists the tools that are each a reasonable reading.

conversations.name: a blocked job, carried through
conversations.pattern: one request leading to the next

turns.say: ok so when does it clear

conversations.name: the tractors stop, in the farmer's own words
conversations.pattern: May 2024: 'the tractors were sitting at the ends of the field', 'auto steer wouldn't engage'

turns.say: all my tractors are sitting at the ends of the field, auto steer won't engage, is it the sun
the dealer says turn off RTK, should I
how long is this going to last

conversations.name: looking back at a bad afternoon
conversations.pattern: 'the GPS showed the tractor going in circles'

turns.say: yesterday afternoon the tractor was going in circles on the GPS while we were planting, what happened
ok put that in the log

conversations.name: and tomorrow?
conversations.pattern: a follow-up that only means something after the answer before it

turns.say: could I spray South Cut this afternoon

conversations.name: the same thing twice, then giving up
conversations.pattern: repeating was the commonest repair, and 'never mind' ended many

conversations.name: asking why
conversations.pattern: 'why are you asking me now?': explanations were a third of breakdowns

turns.say: can I plant the North 40 right now

conversations.name: setting up in passing
conversations.pattern: telling it things in the order they come to mind

turns.say: I've got a new field, the Home Quarter, it's near Grand Island Nebraska

conversations.name: a drone survey
conversations.pattern: a job that is not farming

turns.say: I've got a drone mapping job this afternoon, is the GPS going to behave

conversations.name: the day's work, then the record

turns.say: we got eighty acres of planting done today
send the week's report to the office
I'm a delivery robot in Fargo, can I trust my GPS position right now

conversations.name: off the subject, then back
conversations.pattern: a question it cannot answer, then one it can

turns.say: ok well is the GPS any good today

conversations.name: weeks, then this weekend
conversations.pattern: a longer view, then the near one

turns.say: which weeks are worth booking the custom planter for

conversations.name: thanks, that's all
conversations.pattern: 'thank you' and 'I got it' used to end
